findings.description: specs/skill-workflow/spec.md requirement 'Explainer Frontmatter Without Triggers' mandates that SKILL.md SHALL end with '## Common Rationalizations', '## Red Flags', and '## Verification' sections, but no scenario covers this SHALL. Task 2.1 tests for assert_tail_block_present but the spec lacks a corresponding WHEN/THEN scenario.

specs/skill-workflow/spec.md requirement 'Explainer Distribution Wiring' mandates 'All runtime references from explain-code to sibling skills SHALL use the <skill-base-dir>/../<skill>/ form' but no scenario covers this SHALL. The two scenarios (Manifest validation passes, Tests collected by the default sweep) do not verify the runtime reference form.

design.md D7 states 'three deterministic tests always run in CI and encode the same three behaviours' listing 3 items, but specs/skill-workflow/spec.md has 6 scenarios for the grounding requirement alone (Fresh graph grounds, Stale/absent falls back, Symbol outside coverage, Non-call-tree form, Ambiguous symbol asks, Disclosure line present). The design should clarify which scenarios are covered by the three deterministic tests vs. which require the conditional trajectory harness (task 2.8).

tasks.md task 2.2 declares 'Dependencies: None' but tests the grounding reference written in task 2.5. While this is correct TDD RED→GREEN order (test written before implementation), the logical dependency on the reference file's existence for the test to pass should be noted for implementer clarity.

work-packages.yaml wp-atlas-tree verification step 'tree_deterministic' uses hardcoded target 'coordination_api.py' for the two-run cmp check. If this symbol is renamed or removed from the committed graph, the verification will fail spuriously. Should use a stable fixture symbol or document the assumption.

proposal.md NFR table lists node/edge counts (1,903 / 1,199) that plan-findings.md acknowledges are 'slightly behind current committed graph (~1,953 / 1,228)'. This is documented as 'Left as low (no churn)' but the proposal still carries the stale numbers.
